sources.title: TimSchneider42/cod-vae-16x8-tiny · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A tiny, decode-first COD-VAE that compresses a 3D shape into 16 latent vectors of 8 dimensions = 128 numbers and decodes them back into an occupancy field. Same latent shape as cod-vae-16x8 and cod-vae-16x8-small, but built for pipelines whose wall clock is the decode forward+backward through a frozen decoder (e.g. reconstruction-reward RL): ~6.6M parameters, roughly 4x faster than -small and ...
